source: peak_bw_GBs measured via torch_xla-compiled mul2 reference, n=20,971,520 fp32, single logical core (NEURON_RT_NUM_CORES=1), on-device latency via neuron-profile (see core/nki_timer.py bench_nki). Stable across n=14.7M-21M (577-583 GB/s), taken at largest tested case for consistency with other reported metrics. Custom NKI kernel currently achieves ~98 GB/s on the same case (free_tile_size=16384, not yet autotuned).
peak_tflops_source: Per-LOGICAL-NeuronCore. NEURON_RT_NUM_CORES=1 does NOT give one physical core on trn2: `neuron-ls` reports logical-neuroncore-config=2, so one logical core is TWO physical NeuronCore-v3s.
